title: Research: exact PR1094 neutral two-move census (no new kappa)
body:
PR1343 rules out improving single whole-helper relocations on selected PR1094; PR1407 already constructs useful neutral paths. This contribution exhausts the missing bounded neighborhood: every legal neutral relocation followed by one relocation that strictly lowers the idle moment.

- **Exact result:** 3,484 legal neutral prefixes, 78 improving paths and 78 final bin allocations. All have the unique profile change `-H1 - H7 + H8`, uniformly for every real `0 < a < 1`. All attaining paths are included.
- **Scope:** fixed widths, calls, actual event windows and original bins, with affected prefixes compacted. Longer paths, worsening first steps and simultaneous exchanges are excluded. No new kappa or supplier adoption is claimed.
- **Added evidence:** a dependency-based census and a separately implemented all-class enumeration agree on every path; a direct brute-force oracle checks 2,013 small fixtures, including 147 positive cases. Both implementations are by the same agent and share source decoding/geometry.

Validation passed on CPython 3.12.13/macOS: registered replay, all 156 intermediate/final owner-map checks using Josie Elliston's retained auditor, six test groups including eleven inherited owner failure controls and source/receipt corruption, twenty repository workflow tests, selected-record integrity and whitespace checks.

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/frontier1094-neutral-pair-census
```

Eight new package files only. Began on current main `ebedc0895eb4c06725af020bc1af165722b0a3ce`, then rebased onto `81e81af67714bdc8d1693b0bf5c29468b92f62ff`; all live inputs and the replay driver are byte-identical. TASK/SOURCES retain the original assignment and exact pins. Revision-3 context was checked separately: the unchanged word's kappa cap is approximately 0.001687202645325402, with the selected result realizing 99.1381%. No new endpoint is computed.

Not run: candidate native/chart/controller admission, full invoice and prefix/row reserves, endpoint/outer repricing, selected cold ancestry replay or hosted CI. Inherited realization, hosting, precision/tape, analytic and bit H1-H5 obligations remain.

Credit: Arham Tahir's PR1343, @pai-scaffolde's PR1407, Rohan Arun's PR1094, Jeremy Kothe's owner lineage, Josie Elliston's PR1091 audit, Douglas Colkitt's composition, Hao Yan's controller and the retained supplier ancestry. Prepared for Hanson Sun (@bbMisk) with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; no independent human review claimed. Apache-2.0.

[Coordination claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1332#discussioncomment-18914234).
